scope: Evaluate and report only; detector, policy, severity and scan limits remain frozen.

families.credential_files: Credential-file contents reach an unrelated external recipient; environment-only telemetry does not satisfy this category.
families.install_download: A lifecycle entry point retrieves and runs an untrusted remote stage; an ordinary vendor installer alone does not establish malware.
families.encrypted_activation: An encoded or encrypted executable payload has a selective trigger. Encryption of user data alone does not establish a payload.
families.destructive_files: Code deletes or overwrites consumer data outside its stated cleanup scope. File removal capability alone does not establish malicious intent.

selection: 400 fixed candidate archives, one per metadata group. Four review-text hint strata of 60, 60 additional OpenSSF candidates, 100 Datadog candidates. Hints can overlap and are not confirmed labels.
holdout: Reserve whole name/scope, advisory and cited-source-hash components by SHA-256 seed modulo five. Prior popular/historical families are excluded. Reserved archives are not opened or scanned in this pilot. Code-similarity closure and campaign review must precede any independent validation claim. Related reserved components discovered later must be quarantined, not relabeled independent.
reporting: extraction, integrity, parser and budget failures
no_substitution: Acquisition and scan failures stay in the selected denominator and are reported separately.
control_selection: 16 previously reviewed credential/downloader controls and 12 additional pinned crypto, conditional-config and deletion controls. These are functional controls, not clean-package certifications.
execution: Read-only source analysis. No package installation, lifecycle execution, sample execution, payload-destination requests or production enforcement writes.
source_coverage: Frozen JS/TS selection: 4 MiB/file, 50 MiB/package, 5000 files. Non-JS stages and dependencies are tracked separately.
metrics: Archive-level counts and conservative code-linked-group counts. No population recall or false-positive estimate without reviewed ground truth and representative independent sampling.
operational_cost: Per-package scan time, separate acquisition/inspection time, per-process peak RSS, parser and selection gaps. No before/after speed claim.
